scope: 联网 primary-source research and new disjoint report only; no product, art, driver, menu, production, or hardware changes

sources.title: FluxGarage RoboEyes
sources.evidence: Mood, position, blink, idle, oneshot animations, current/next geometry and max framerate update are documented/source-visible.
sources.oled_dependency: 50 fps continuous interpolation and random interval variation
sources.companion_transfer: semantic targets, finite channels, fixed deterministic keyframes

sources.title: Adafruit Uncanny_Eyes
sources.evidence: Official repo supports 1.5in OLED/1.44in TFT, generated graphics headers and ARM-specific rendering path.
sources.companion_transfer: pre-generated component/frame authoring, not color or continuous threshold animation

sources.title: Adafruit Electronic Animated Eyes guide
sources.evidence: Documents OLED/TFT hardware, optional joystick/button/photocell inputs and eyelid threshold-based blink rendering.
sources.companion_transfer: input-to-target mapping and legal component authoring

sources.title: Misty II Interaction System
sources.evidence: Action language includes PAUSE, STOP, HALT, RESET-LAYERS, RESET-EYES, IMAGE, VIDEO, LED and head commands.
sources.oled_dependency: none for scheduling concept; display is color/layered
sources.companion_transfer: bounded scripts, cleanup, interruption and recovery semantics

sources.title: Gaze behaviour, believability, likability and the iCat
sources.evidence: 10 fps fixed animation engine, merge/fade channels, gaze target input and modular gaze subsystems for gaze shift, pursuit, VOR and vergence.
sources.oled_dependency: 10 fps actuator rendering and continuous movement models
sources.companion_transfer: state-vector architecture, channel separation, target-to-settle scheduling

sources.title: I Reach Faster When I See You Look
sources.evidence: Full robot gaze preceded speech and produced anticipatory human action; eye occlusion changed timing and required waiting for head motion.
sources.companion_transfer: gaze lead before semantic peak, with fixed measurable ordering

sources.title: Analysis of Timing and Effect of Visual Cue on Turn-Taking in HRI
sources.evidence: Direct study of visual cue timing, gaze/face cue sequencing and turn-taking risk when timing is missed.
sources.companion_transfer: fixed cue order and hold windows, tested in discrete traces

r6_local_evidence.evidence_summary: R6 accepted clean-refresh baseline and offline controller-window/pixel-parity artifacts are treated as immutable regression constraints; this report did not edit them.

ranked_rules: locked-V9 components only; preserve white highlight and sparkle
bounded micro-action channels with no transient residue
fixed priority: cleanup/safety > touch > semantic emotion > idle
R6 lower-driver and offline parity invariants remain protected
